name: Hentai Yuusha no Nakadashi Eiyuuki
original_name: 変態勇者の中出し英雄記
source:
To f*ck the queen, you must overthrow the devil king!

The Queen of Midvale's beauty is legendary.

I heard about her and came running. Not how it sounds.

Hey, I came all this way (still not how it sounds).
Where the hell is the queen?
What a waste of time, she's not even here.

Hang on, I can blame this on monsters.
